parsed.explanation: Dependent territory: no documented parent-imposed traveler restriction. No trans-specific criminalization or public-expression ban is stated. The absence of gender-identity-specific anti-discrimination/hate-crime grounds, self-ID, and nonbinary recognition is mainly a resident gap/open question, not an established visitor-facing restriction. Violence, police, border, custody, care, and facility data are thin; silence is not full safety, but the structural record shows no organized targeting. Open questions and limited trans-specific recourse keep it below low-risk anchors.
